item.content:encoded:
Open procurement notice

Expression of Interest: Rental of a Kitchen

Kenya Methodist University invites experienced vendors to submit proposals for operating the vacant kitchen at the Main Campus in Meru.

Tender numberKeMU/EO1/015/2026
Site visit13 October 2026
10:00 a.m.
Submission deadline19 October 2026
11:00 a.m.

Opportunity overview

The successful vendor will provide diverse, high-quality and affordable food and beverage services for students, faculty and staff. The contract period is one year, renewable.

  • Daily food preparation and service aligned with campus operating hours.
  • High-quality, friendly and efficient customer service.
  • Strict compliance with food-handling, health and safety standards.
  • Affordable menu pricing with strong value for students.
Site visit: Interested bidders should assemble at the Procurement Office, 1st Floor, Administration Block, Main Campus Meru, on 13 October 2026 at 10:00 a.m.

Required submission documents

  • A one-page service delivery proposal.
  • County Government business permit.
  • Valid medical certificates for kitchen staff.
  • Certificate of incorporation or registration.
  • Valid Tax Compliance Certificate.
  • Current medical, health and food-handler certification for the firm.
  • Financial proposal stating monthly rent and utilities in Kenya shillings.

Submission: Responses must be submitted in hard copy and duplicate before 19 October 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Refer to the official EOI document for the complete requirements and evaluation conditions.

View official EOI document Download PDF

Official Kenya Methodist University procurement notice. Technical evaluation carries 70%, while the financial proposal carries 30%.

item.title: KeMU Pharmacy Students Shine at the 2026 World Pharmacy Day Intervarsity Olympiad
item.dc:creator: Linus Muriuki
item.description:
KeMU Pharmacy students emerged Overall Second Best University out of nine universities at the 2026 World Pharmacy Day Intervarsity Olympiad.

The post KeMU Pharmacy Students Shine at the 2026 World Pharmacy Day Intervarsity Olympiad first appeared on Kenya Methodist University.
item.content:encoded:
Kenya Methodist University (KeMU) Pharmacy students have once again demonstrated excellence after emerging Overall Second Best University out of nine universities at the 2026 World Pharmacy Day Intervarsity Olympiad.

Five trophies for KeMU

  • Overall ranking: 2nd position out of 9 universities
  • Preclinical skills: 1st position
  • Clinical skills: 1st position
  • General pharmacy quiz: 1st position
  • Industrial skills: 2nd position

This remarkable achievement marks four consecutive years of outstanding performance at the World Pharmacy Day Intervarsity Olympiad, reflecting the excellence, dedication and practical competence of KeMU Pharmacy students.

Competing against eight other pharmacy schools from across the country, the KeMU team delivered an outstanding performance.

Congratulations to our Pharmacy students and the entire Pharmacy Department for flying the KeMU flag high.

The post KeMU Pharmacy Students Shine at the 2026 World Pharmacy Day Intervarsity Olympiad first appeared on Kenya Methodist University.
